exam_price_notes: Free; requires a free HubSpot account
exam_rules: Exams are taken online via the HubSpot Academy platform at app.hubspot.com/academy. No external proctor is required. Candidates may use notes and reference materials during the exam. A free HubSpot account is required to access the exam. Certifications are valid for 2 years and must be renewed by retaking the exam.
id_requirements: HubSpot account login required. No government-issued ID required. All exams are unproctored and taken online at app.hubspot.com/academy.

lifecycle.summary: Confirmed current on the issuer host on 2026-09-19: "Discover the power of inbound marketing, a customer-centric approach that attracts and creates valuable experiences for your customers, in this HubSpot Academy certification course!"

renewal_options: Certifications expire after 2 years. Renewal requires passing the current version of the exam. HubSpot may send reminder emails before expiration.

retake_policy.notes: No waiting period between attempts. Candidates may retake the exam immediately after a failed attempt at no cost.
